phase3_findings.description: tests/unit/test_sql_runner_cleanup.py module docstring (lines 6-10, rewritten by the diff) says the outer finally: cleanup guards a secondary exception from cursor.close() / conn.close() when a SELECT raises; at head the outer finally of MySQLRunner._run_sql_blocking only calls conn.close() and the SELECT path never closes its SSDictCursor. Capped as behavior-inert prose (test docstring, no reader).

The URL-scheme rule lives in four places with different tests: DatabaseConfig._supported_url_scheme (config.py) accepts mysql, mysql+... and sqlite...; build_sql_runner (factory.py), probe_database (preflight.py) and sqlglot_dialect_for_url (readonly.py) accept any scheme starting with mysql (mysqlx:// passes). DatabaseConfig.dialect does not lowercase. Correct today because every config path validates first; suggests carrying a normalized engine on the type.
